name: zerocool-agent-tools
description: The opencode CLI the zerocool agent image spawns (ZEROCOOL_OPENCODE_BIN) and the Gibson MCP server opencode spawns from it (ZEROCOOL_MCP_BIN). Installed with npm ci from this lockfile so both binaries are hash pinned. The server version is the tools/hosts pin; pins.test.ts in claude-gibson fails when they differ.
